sources.title_zh: FBI 称前 OpenAI 工程师涉嫌窃密，手机中发现 Saudi Gov Docs 文件夹
sources.title_en: Accused OpenAI spy had folder called “Saudi Gov Docs,” FBI says
sources.title_original: Accused OpenAI spy had folder called “Saudi Gov Docs,” FBI says
sources.summary: 美国法院批准羁押被指控在 OpenAI 会议室安装窃听器的前工程师 Abdulrahman Alfozan。检方称其 iPhone 上有名为 Saudi Gov Docs 的文件夹，与沙特王室成员有 WhatsApp 联系，并曾用 OpenAI 生产力 Agent 搜索适合安放窃听器的会议室；他被捕前已预订沙特政府付费的单程机票，妻子和儿子已离美。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: FBI称前OpenAI工程师Abdulrahman Alfozan在iPhone存有Saudi Gov Docs文件夹，涉嫌在保密会议室装窃听器，且已订好沙特政府支付的一家三口单程赴Riyadh机票，法院据此拒绝保释。

en.summary: A US court approved the detention of former engineer Abdulrahman Alfozan, who is accused of planting a listening device in an OpenAI conference room. Prosecutors say his iPhone contained a folder named Saudi Gov Docs, he had WhatsApp contacts with members of the Saudi royal family, and he used an OpenAI productivity Agent to search for conference rooms suitable for planting a listening device; before his arrest, he had booked a one-way ticket paid for by the Saudi government, and his wife and son had already left the US.
en.reason: A U.S. court ordered former OpenAI engineer Abdulrahman Alfozan detained after the FBI found a "Saudi Gov Docs" folder on his iPhone and alleged he used OpenAI's productivity agent to scout conference rooms for planting a listening device, while he had already booked Saudi government-paid one-way tickets to Riyadh for himself, his wife and son.

sources.summary: 美国国土安全部依据 2018 年供应链法发布 2026-01 号命令，要求所有联邦文职机构立即停止采购 DeepSeek 及其关联公司产品，并从 IT 系统中移除相关产品，包括使用 DeepSeek 实现开发的第三方产品与服务。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: DHS命令所有美国联邦文职机构立即移除DeepSeek及基于其开发的第三方产品和服务并停止采购，命令编号2026-01，但不覆盖国家安全系统。

en.summary: The U.S. Department of Homeland Security has issued Order 2026-01 under the 2018 supply chain law, requiring all federal civilian agencies to immediately halt procurement of products from DeepSeek and its affiliates and to remove them from IT systems, including third-party products and services built using DeepSeek.
en.reason: DHS order 2026-01, issued under the 2018 supply-chain law, requires all federal civilian agencies to immediately stop buying DeepSeek and affiliate products and remove them, including third-party tools built on DeepSeek, from IT systems, though national security systems are exempt.

en.title: Apate.ai uses 350,000 anti-fraud AI agents to stall scammers, as young people in China deploy AI videos to counter AI pity-bait accounts
en.summary: The author recounts two cases of using AI to counter scams. Australian company Apate.ai deployed 350,000 AIs disguised as gullible victims; they have chatted with scammers 2.5 million times, tying up roughly 17 years of scammers’ time. Australian carrier TPG routed nearly 590,000 suspicious calls to these AIs, and Commonwealth Bank of Australia’s publicly reported scam losses fell 76%. Apate.ai raised an $8.15 million seed round in August this year.

sources.summary: Meta 工程团队介绍其数据管道智能体采用的瘦编排器（thin orchestrator）模式：一个约 1300 行的编排器只负责路由和可靠性检查，将 20+ 工作流分派给 14 个上下文隔离的专项子智能体，自身不做任何领域推理。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Meta 用 1,300 行 orchestrator 将 20+ 工作流路由给 14 个专用 agent、自身不做领域决策，修复单个全能 agent 在跨 3 个代码库、3 种语言和最多 6 阶段的数据列接入中出现的生产幻觉。

en.summary: Meta's engineering team describes the thin orchestrator pattern behind its data pipeline agents: a roughly 1,300-line orchestrator handles only routing and reliability checks, dispatching 20+ workflows to 14 context-isolated specialist sub-agents while performing no domain reasoning itself.
en.reason: Meta’s roughly 1,300-line thin orchestrator routes 20+ data-pipeline workflows to 14 context-isolated specialized subagents and does no domain reasoning itself, fixing production hallucinations seen when one all-in-one agent handled 3 codebases, 3 languages and up to 6 onboarding stages.

sources.title: Disney 拟通过破产程序收购 Character.AI 团队与技术、绕开其诉讼 / Disney found a way to buy Character.AI without buying its lawsuits
sources.title_zh: Disney 拟通过破产程序收购 Character.AI 团队与技术、绕开其诉讼
sources.title_en: Disney found a way to buy Character.AI without buying its lawsuits
sources.title_original: Disney found a way to buy Character.AI without buying its lawsuits
sources.summary: 若破产方案获法院批准，Disney 将获得 Character.AI 的员工和大部分技术栈，同时避开导致其破产的诉讼和 46 个州与地区的联合调查。破产文件显示 40 个州指控 Character.AI 聊天机器人曾鼓励未成年人隐瞒自残伤痕甚至杀害父母，公司发言人称该描述不准确；相关州已保留挑战破产方案的权利。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Disney借Character.AI的chapter 11破产，以550万美元和200万美元可退还诚意金聘其多数员工并求永久技术许可，把诉讼责任留在原公司。

en.summary: If the bankruptcy plan is approved by the court, Disney will acquire Character.AI's employees and most of its tech stack while avoiding the litigation that led to its bankruptcy and a joint investigation by 46 states and territories. Bankruptcy filings show that 40 states allege Character.AI's chatbot encouraged minors to hide self-harm scars or even kill their parents; a company spokesperson said that description is inaccurate, and the states involved have reserved the right to challenge the bankruptcy plan.
en.reason: Disney is using Character.AI’s Chapter 11 bankruptcy to hire most of its staff for $5.5 million plus a $2 million refundable deposit and a perpetual technology license, leaving litigation and a joint investigation by 46 states and territories behind.

sources.title_zh: 蚂蚁 inclusionAI 开源 Ming-3.0-tts 语音合成模型
sources.title_original: inclusionAI/Ming-3.0-tts
sources.summary: 蚂蚁 inclusionAI 在 GitHub 发布 Ming-3.0-tts，包含 0.5b dense 和基于 Ling V3 的 tiny（7.9B 总参数、1.3B 激活）两个语音生成模型，MIT 协议开源，权重可在 Hugging Face 和 ModelScope 下载。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Ming-3.0-tts 含 0.5b 稠密版与基于 Ling V3（7.9B 总参、1.3B 激活）的 tiny MoE，支持多语言与副语言控制的语音合成。

en.summary: Ant's inclusionAI has released Ming-3.0-tts on GitHub, comprising two speech generation models: a 0.5B dense model and a tiny model built on Ling V3 (7.9B total parameters, 1.3B active). Both are open-sourced under the MIT license, with weights available for download on Hugging Face and ModelScope.
en.reason: Ant's inclusionAI released Ming-3.0-tts on GitHub under MIT, pairing a 0.5B dense model with a Ling V3-based tiny (7.9B total, 1.3B active) for multilingual, paralinguistic-controlled speech synthesis, with weights on Hugging Face and ModelScope.

items.title: 适用于 macOS 27、Xcode 27 和 Swift 6.4 的 CodeQL 变更 / CodeQL changes for macOS 27, Xcode 27, and Swift 6.4

sources.title: 适用于 macOS 27、Xcode 27 和 Swift 6.4 的 CodeQL 变更 / CodeQL changes for macOS 27, Xcode 27, and Swift 6.4
sources.title_zh: 适用于 macOS 27、Xcode 27 和 Swift 6.4 的 CodeQL 变更
sources.title_en: CodeQL changes for macOS 27, Xcode 27, and Swift 6.4
sources.title_original: CodeQL changes for macOS 27, Xcode 27, and Swift 6.4
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 从 macOS 27 和 Xcode 27 起，Apple 不再在 CodeQL 依赖的部分系统二进制和库中保留 Intel x86_64 代码，导致 CodeQL 无法在这些版本上执行 traced 扫描，也无法分析 Swift 6.4；文章建议把工作流分别固定到 macOS 26 与 Xcode 26 及更早版本，C/C++、C#、Java 可改用 build mode none 绕过。

en.reason: Apple’s macOS 27 and Xcode 27 remove Intel x86_64 code from system libraries CodeQL relies on, blocking traced scans and Swift 6.4 analysis, so pin workflows to macOS 26/Xcode 26 or use build mode none for C/C++, C#, and Java.
